sentences: Next April, under {65s|sixty-fives} were losing {£8,000|eight thousand pounds} of cash ISA room.
Then this week's Budget did something savers didn't expect.
It scrapped the cut. Your cash ISA limit stays at {£20,000.|twenty thousand pounds.}
The same Budget raised the tax on savings interest outside ISAs.
So the tax-free room you nearly lost just got more valuable.
Outside, the tax rate rises next April. Inside, it stays zero.
So when you hear the Budget only hit savers, remember:
